text.en:
Article three hundred forty of the Revised Penal Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Art. 340. Corruption of Minors. Any person who shall promote or facilitate the prostitution or corruption of
persons underage to satisfy the lust of another, shall be punished by prision mayor, and if the culprit is a
public officer or employee, including those in government-owned or controlled corporations, he shall also
suffer the penalty of temporary absolute disqualification."
